1. Engagement Scope

ACPWB conducted a targeted compliance review of American Institute for HR Technology Research's executive compensation programs, focusing on adherence to EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD); Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976. The review covered all compensation actions for the top 232 executives for the fiscal year ending 2009-10-24.

2. Methodology

ACPWB performed a "peer benchmark" of American Institute for HR Technology Research's compliance function, comparing its staffing levels, budget, and technology stack to those of 232 similarly sized companies in the Demand Response Providers sector.

4. Detailed Findings
XXR-1499-001INFORMATIONALIN PROGRESS
Observation

Pay transparency report for 3 does not meet EU Pay Transparency Directive requirements

Corrective Action Required

Develop and implement a centralized process for creating and posting job requisitions to ensure all external postings in covered jurisdictions include the required salary range disclosures.

Management Response

The finding is valid. A budget of $232K has been approved to procure the necessary technology to automate this control. Implementation is projected to take 58 weeks.

Owner: Manager of Total Rewards Programs • Due: 2010-02-28
XXR-6776-002INFORMATIONALREMEDIATED
Observation

PCAOB Auditing Standard No. 18 requires disclosure of related party transactions not found in the 2009 10-K

Corrective Action Required

Establish a formal policy recoupment tracking log and assign ownership to a designated compliance officer. All recoupment events must be documented within 30 days of trigger event and reported quarterly to the Audit Committee.

Management Response

We agree with the finding. A request for proposal (RFP) has been issued to select a vendor to assist with the implementation of the corrective action. The vendor selection is expected to be complete by 2009-10-24.

Owner: Project Manager • Due: 2010-01-28
XXR-2757-003INFORMATIONALOPEN
Observation

Genetic information (GINA) requested on post-offer medical questionnaire for 232 new hires

Corrective Action Required

The 401(k) plan fiduciary committee shall formalize its vendor review process, including the issuance of RFPs and documentation of the selection rationale for all plan service providers.

Management Response

The finding is accepted. The required training has been developed and assigned to all 232 affected employees with a mandatory completion date of 2009-10-24. Completion rates will be tracked and reported to the compliance department.

Owner: Senior Manager of Strategic Initiatives • Due: 2009-11-28
XXR-6367-004HIGHREMEDIATED
Observation

ACA Form 1095-C contains incorrect offer of coverage codes for 232 full-time employees

Corrective Action Required

American Institute for HR Technology Research shall conduct a full pay equity analysis across all protected class segments within 45 days of report issuance and submit a remediation plan to ACPWB for review.

Management Response

We concur with the finding. The process has been redesigned, and user acceptance testing is scheduled for the week of 2009-10-24. Full implementation will follow immediately after successful testing.

Owner: Chief Privacy Officer • Due: 2009-12-28
XXR-2813-005LOWMONITORING
Observation

Pregnancy Discrimination Act (PDA) accommodation process is not formally documented or consistently applied

Corrective Action Required

A third-party specialist will be engaged annually to provide §280G "golden parachute" calculations for all named executive officers in connection with any potential change-in-control scenario.

Management Response

This issue has been escalated to the executive steering committee for prioritization and resource allocation. A formal response will be provided following the committee's next scheduled meeting on 2009-10-24.

Owner: Senior Manager of Marketing Programs • Due: 2009-11-28
XXR-2806-006INFORMATIONALIN PROGRESS
Observation

Variable pay accrual methodology inconsistent with EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD); Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 disclosure requirements

Corrective Action Required

The vendor onboarding process will be updated to include a mandatory, risk-based anti-corruption due diligence step for all international third-party intermediaries.

Management Response

The finding is valid. The required report has been developed and is now generated and distributed automatically on a weekly basis. See attached sample report as evidence.

Owner: Director of Financial Reporting • Due: 2009-11-28
